name: Ocean.io
summary: Lookalike company and people search, company and person enrichment and bulk lookups.

api_token.description: an Ocean.io API token (app.ocean.io, API settings)

notes: Credit-priced per result: searches 0.2, enrich 0.1, bulk lookup 0.05, autocomplete 0.1 per call. Email reveal (1 credit) and phone reveal (10) are asynchronous and deliver to a webhook, so they are not listed.
Paging uses searchAfter: send the value from the previous response.
Search 'preview' endpoints exist only on enterprise or older plans (402 otherwise).
The docs also accept the token as an apiToken query parameter; sending both a header and a query token is an error.

endpoints.name: Get credit usage over time
endpoints.summary: Credits consumed through the public API per endpoint, by hour, day, week or month.
notes: A read over POST.

endpoints.name: List searchable industries, regions, technologies and seniorities
endpoints.summary: The valid values for search filters.
notes: Free.

endpoints.name: Autocomplete company names or domains
endpoints.summary: Up to 15 companies for the start of a name or domain; for picking lookalike seeds.

name.description: Beginning of a company name or domain.

notes: A read over POST. 0.1 credits per call.

endpoints.name: Autocomplete company keywords
endpoints.summary: Valid keyword values for company search.

limit.description: How many to return, default 5, max 15.

notes: A read over POST. 0.1 credits per call.

endpoints.name: Autocomplete job titles
endpoints.summary: Matching job titles for people search.

limit.description: How many to return, default 5, max 15.

notes: A read over POST. 0.1 credits per call.

endpoints.name: Autocomplete locations
endpoints.summary: Location filter codes (filterCode values) for a typed place.

limit.description: How many to return, default 5, max 15.

locationType.description: Whether the codes are for company or people filters.

notes: A read over POST. 0.1 credits per call.

endpoints.name: Autocomplete skills
endpoints.summary: Valid skill values for people search.

limit.description: How many to return, default 5, max 15.

notes: A read over POST. 0.1 credits per call.

endpoints.name: Search companies (lookalike and filters)
endpoints.summary: Company search by lookalike domains and filters: size, revenue, industry, location, technology, funding, hiring and more.

searchAfter.description: The searchAfter value from the previous response, for the next page.

companiesFilters.description: Filters, all optional: lookalikeDomains, includeDomains, excludeDomains, companySizes (e.g. '51-200'), revenues (e.g. '1-10M'), industries {industries, mode}, linkedinIndustries, primaryLocations {includeCountries (alpha-2), includeRegions, includeCities}, technologies, keywords {anyOf, allOf, noneOf}, fundingRound, headcountGrowth, jobPostings, buyingSignals, yearFounded {from, to}, minRelevance/maxRelevance (A to C).

peopleFilters.description: Optional: require companies that have people matching, using the people filters of people.search.

fields.description: Fields to return; asking for fewer is faster and lighter.

notes: A read over POST: the filters are in the body.
0.2 credits per result. Page with searchAfter.
Valid industries, regions and technologies come from data_fields.list.

endpoints.name: Search people (lookalike and filters)
endpoints.summary: People search by title, seniority, department, skills, location and job changes, plus company filters.

searchAfter.description: The searchAfter value from the previous response, for the next page.

peopleFilters.description: Filters, all optional: lookalikeLinkedinHandles, countries (alpha-2), seniorities, departments {departments, mode}, jobTitleKeywords {allOf, anyOf, noneOf}, skills {allOf, anyOf, noneOf}, states, cities, names, changedPositionAfter/Before ('2023-01'), laborStatusOpenToWork, laborStatusHiring, excludePeopleIds.

companiesFilters.description: Optional company filters, same shape as companies.search.

peoplePerCompany.description: Max people per company; leave out for all.

jobTitleThreshold.description: Job title similarity threshold, 0 to 1, default 0.8.

notes: A read over POST: the filters are in the body.
0.2 credits per result. Page with searchAfter. Keep each result's id: it is the input to email and phone reveal.
Emails and phones are not in search results; reveal is a separate, webhook-delivered call that this entry does not list.

endpoints.name: Enrich a company
endpoints.summary: Match one company from name, domain, social links or address and return firmographics.

company.description: Identifiers: domain (strongest), linkedin, name, registrationNumber, email, phone, countryCode, state, city, address and social page URLs.

people.description: People to help match the company.

fields.description: Fields to return; asking for fewer is faster and lighter.

notes: A read over POST.
0.1 credits per result. HTTP 201 means the domain is not indexed yet and crawling started; nothing is charged, retry in 2 to 5 minutes.

endpoints.name: Enrich a person
endpoints.summary: Match one person from name, title, LinkedIn URL, email or company and return their profile.

person.description: Identifiers: linkedin (strongest), id, name, firstName, lastName, jobTitle, email, phone, country.

company.description: Optional current company, same identifiers as company.enrich.

notes: A read over POST.
0.1 credits per result. The revealEmails and revealPhones options deliver by webhook and charge extra, so they are not listed here.

endpoints.name: Look up companies by domain in bulk
endpoints.summary: Up to 1,000 domains in one call; unknown domains return company: null.

fields.description: Fields to return; asking for fewer is faster and lighter.

notes: A read over POST.
0.05 credits per result.

endpoints.name: Look up people by LinkedIn handle or Ocean id in bulk
endpoints.summary: Profiles for up to 1,000 identifiers; unmatched ones are omitted (compare totalRequested and totalFound).

linkedinHandles.description: LinkedIn URL slugs, the part after linkedin.com/in/.

notes: A read over POST.
0.05 credits per result; max 1,000 identifiers combined.

endpoints.name: Pre-load domains into the database
endpoints.summary: Checks domains and starts crawling missing ones so later lookups and enrichment hit.
notes: A read over POST: it only asks Ocean to fetch public data. Free.
Domains already indexed come back in successfulDomains; others in triggeredDomains. Retry after 2 to 5 minutes.
